title: Launch readiness canvas + KPI timeline
content:
Summary:
This is a compact, actionable launch readiness canvas + KPI timeline for the upcoming product-ops rollout (internal name: Orion). Designed to be a single-sheet view for product, eng, SRE, and CS to confirm go/no-go across technical, quality, and business signals. Treat as living doc through D-0.

Goal / Success criteria (business & technical):
- Primary business goal: 5% DAU lift for the new lightweight inference mode within 30d.
- Revenue target: convert 0.6% of trial users to paid within 14d post-launch.
- Technical SLOs: 95th pct latency < 220ms on gen endpoints, error rate < 0.2% for first 72h.
- Launch decision rule: all critical gates green + no outstanding SEV2/SEV1 issues assigned to launch team.

High-level timeline (milestone | target date | owner | RAG):
- Feature freeze (code + infra): 2025-03-03 | Marcus Li | Amber
- Canary enablement window: 2025-03-10 to 2025-03-12 | SRE | Amber
- Data export/prep complete: 2025-03-07 | Data Ops | Green
- Final QA sign-off: 2025-03-09 | QA lead: Jordan Kim | Amber
- Launch (prod traffic toggle): 2025-03-12 | PM on-call: Aisha Patel | TBD

KPI Canvas (name | definition | owner | pre-launch baseline | target (14d) | source | alert threshold):
- Latency P95 (gen-endpoint): 95th percentile time for text gen end-to-end | Marcus Li | 185ms | <220ms | internal-metrics/gen | >240ms
- Error rate (5xx & timeout): percent requests failing | SRE | 0.08% | <0.2% | prometheus/alerts | >0.5%
- Daily active users (feature opt-ins): users who hit new mode | Growth PM: Sofia Ramos | 0 (pilot) | 5% DAU lift | analytics/events | <3% lift
- Trial-to-paid conversion (14d cohort): percent of trial users became paid | Revenue Ops | 0.4% | >=0.6% | stripe/cohort | <0.35%
- Cost per 1k tokens (avg): infra cost normalized | Finance | $1.45 | <=$1.20 | billing/ops | >$1.60

Readiness checklist (D-14, D-7, D-3, D-0) with owner notes and quick status tokens:
- D-14: Rollout plan doc shared (Confluence), feature flag created, contingency rollback plan drafted | Owner: Aisha Patel | STATUS: complete (link: CONFLUENCE-1234)
- D-7: End-to-end perf test with production-like load; baseline traces captured; canary plan approved | Owner: Marcus Li | STATUS: running (perf tests scheduled 2025-03-04)
- D-3: Final infra capacity commit (Dedicated pools), monitoring dashboards configured & alert runbooks drafted | Owner: SRE (Renee O'Connor) | STATUS: pending
- D-0 (launch day): SMS+Slack on-call list, quick rollback playbook, comms template for incidents, customer success briefed | Owner: Product Ops | STATUS: draft

Quality gates (must be green to proceed):
- Gate 1: Core functionality tests pass in canary (smoke + regression) - owner QA
- Gate 2: Load perf within SLOs for 3 consecutive 30-min windows - owner SRE
- Gate 3: No blocker security alerts & SCA scan results reviewed - owner Security
- Gate 4: Support playbook + KB article published - owner CS

Launch safety & rollback plan (short):
- Feature flag gating: immediate toggle to previous stable variant.
- Quick rollback checklist: 1) toggle flag -> 2) verify traffic fallback in canary -> 3) scale down new pools -> 4) run smoke tests -> 5) notify stakeholders (channel #launch-orion).
- Rollback owner: Marcus Li (exec), SRE exec: Renee O'Connor.

Post-launch monitoring (first 24h and 72h watchlist):
- 0-4h: Latency P95, Error rate, 5xx spike pattern, Redis KV miss rate. Pager routes to SRE.
- 4-24h: Feature adoption curves, token spend trends, top-10 slow endpoints per model. PM/Finance watch.
- 24-72h: Cohort conversion early signs, model quality regressions (eval harness), user support volume. CS + Product Ops watch.

Escalation matrix (who to ping by issue type):
- Sev1 infra outage -> SRE oncall -> Eng lead -> CEO if >30m
- Quality regressions (model output) -> Applied ML lead (Marcus) -> Product -> rollback if >5% bad samples
- Billing/cost spikes -> Finance -> infra throttles and autoscale pause

Risk register (top 5):
- R1: Canary traffic not representative -> Mitigation: seed with synthetic replay + small real traffic cohort | Owner: SRE
- R2: Latency spikes from cache warming -> Mitigation: pre-warm KV caches, run warmup job 12h before launch | Owner: Infra
- R3: Unexpected cost run-up on quantized variants -> Mitigation: cost cap alerts, emergency scale-down policy | Owner: Finance + Infra
- R4: Support docs not complete -> Mitigation: CS pre-brief + staged KB release | Owner: CS
- R5: Third-party telemetry outage -> Mitigation: fallback metrics export to S3 + local sampling | Owner: Observability

Operational runbook snippets (copyable):
- 'Check P95: curl metrics endpoint /dash/p95?env=prod&service=gen - if >240ms then hold release and notify SRE'
- 'Rollback: curl POST /api/flags/orion -d "state=off" then run smoke test endpoint /health/gen'

Open questions / action items (owner | note):
- Jordan Kim | Need test matrix for new edge-case prompts - QA to produce by 2025-03-05
- Sofia Ramos | Growth experiments: default opt-in vs. opt-out split? Need AB plan by D-7
- Marcus Li | Confirm quantized model variant is compatible with autoscaler - infra ticket JIRA-OPS-981

Quick links & references (copy into Slack if needed):
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (launch plan)
- Jira epic: JIRA-ORION-GLUE (epic)
- GitHub: github.com/redwood-inference/release/PR-342 (release PR)

Notes to self / informal:
- Keep this sheet minimal. If something looks sticky at D-3, escalate early.
- Post-launch retro: capture 3 wins, 3 learnings, and 2 action items for next rollout.

Last updated by: Aisha Patel (product-ops) on 2025-03-03.
